title: Semantic groups
subtitle: Group related incidents by label values (Alertmanager-style group_by).

states.empty_description: Define a group to collapse related incidents by shared labels.

confirm.delete: Delete this group? Incidents stay; only the grouping rule is removed.

drawer.subtitle: Matchers select which incidents this group applies to; group_by sets the grouping key.
drawer.matchers_description: All matchers must match an incident's labels for this group to apply. No matchers = matches every incident.
drawer.group_by_description: Incidents sharing the same values for these label keys collapse into one group.

hints.enabled: Disabled groups are skipped during grouping.
hints.group_by: Comma-separated label keys, e.g. service, region.

import.title: Import semantic groups
import.subtitle: Paste a JSON array of groups (or { groups: [...] }).
import.expects_array: Expected a non-empty array of groups.
